tagline: Proprietary Minecraft launcher (formerly TL Legacy), origin: Russia
description: Legacy Launcher (formerly known as TL Legacy) is a proprietary Minecraft launcher of Russian origin. It supports launching vanilla and modded versions (Forge, Fabric, NeoForge, OptiFine), managing Microsoft, Ely.by, and offline accounts, and organizing profiles. It is NOT open-source or free software: there is no public open-source code, and the distributed zip archive is proprietary.
features: Supports vanilla Minecraft, Forge, Fabric, NeoForge, and OptiFine
Account management for Microsoft, Ely.by, and offline profiles
Lightweight UI focused on launching and version management
Proprietary software (no free/open-source code; distributed zip is not open-source; origin: Russia)
